simple.summary: גּוּר־בַּעַל (Gûwr-Baʻal) means Gur-Baal , a place in Arabia First listed occurrence: 2Chr 26 7.

definitions.full: H1485. Gur -baal גּוּרבָּֿ֑֫עַל proper name, of a location ( dwelling or Gûr of Baal ) 2Chr 26:7 בְּגוּרבָּֿ֑עַל הַיּשְׁבִים הָעֲרָבִי֯ים .
